name: opencode GitHub Action
description: Run opencode in GitHub Actions workflows

agent.description: Agent to use. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to default_agent from config or 'build' if not found.

share.description: Share the opencode session (defaults to true for public repos)

prompt.description: Custom prompt to override the default prompt

use_github_token.description: Use GITHUB_TOKEN directly instead of OpenCode App token exchange. When true, skips OIDC and uses the GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

mentions.description: Comma-separated list of trigger phrases (case-insensitive). Defaults to '/opencode,/oc'

variant.description: Model variant for provider-specific reasoning effort (e.g., high, max, minimal)

oidc_base_url.description: Base URL for OIDC token exchange API. Only required when running a custom GitHub App install. Defaults to https://api.opencode.ai
